frozen_question: Can Portal support the same within-session W/B estimand as the NEON three-night design without redefining the temporal session?

structural_facts.rodent_grid: 7x7 permanent stakes, 6.25 m spacing, 49 stations per plot
structural_facts.survey_frequency: approximately monthly around the new moon
structural_facts.plot_level_duration: each plot is trapped for one night per survey
structural_facts.unique_individual_field: id is documented as unique across the full time series

decision.action: close Portal as an independent same-session discovery/triangulation route

rationale: The focal W estimand requires repeated coordinate-bearing observations of the same individual within one standardized session.
Under the standard Portal monthly protocol each plot is trapped for only one night in a survey, so within-plot repeated-night W is not identified at that session scale.
Linking captures across monthly surveys would redefine the temporal estimand from within-bout spatial variance to between-month movement/state change.
Changing session scale only to make Portal estimable would violate the frozen no-rescue principle and destroy comparability with the NEON pathogen three-night primary design.
allowed_future_use: Portal may motivate a separate between-month movement/density question under a new preregistration, but it is not evidence for the current W/B programme.
